sections: IPC 397 (Robbery with Attempt to Cause Death)
complainant: Rajesh Mehta (Owner, Mehta Diamond & Jewellery Vault)
incidentLocation: Mehta Diamond Vault, Hill Road, Bandra West, Mumbai
briefFacts: On 12-Oct-2024 at 19:45 hrs, four armed individuals entered Mehta Diamond Vault. The perpetrators threatened staff at gunpoint, disabled CCTV DVR unit, and decamped with high-grade diamond packets and raw bullion. Informers and CCTV camera near Mehboob Studio identified getaway car white Swift (MH-02-CB-8812) driven by Imran Qureshi with Tariq Shaikh. Wiretaps indicate Tariq called a contact saved as 'Raja Bhai' (+91 98201 44892) 18 minutes prior to the assault.

policeStation: Enforcement Directorate / EOW Cyber & Bullion Cell, BKC
incidentLocation: Dave Bullion Office, Zaveri Bazaar & BKC Financial Center, Mumbai
seizedItems: Hawala Ledger Notebook containing secret codes: 'RK-BHI-402'
Fake Export Shipping Invoices under Apex Marine Exports
Encrypted hardware wallet backup seed phrase
briefFacts: EOW raid on Dave Bullion premises following suspicious RTGS spikes. Karan Dave received massive unbilled bullion deposits on 13-Oct-2024, immediately layered into bank account of dummy entity 'Apex Marine Exports' (HDFC-904128841). Recovered physical ledger shows incoming batch referenced as 'Loot 75ct - Token RK-402' with cash disbursement instructions to courier Altaf Memon. Intercepts show Karan Dave in frequent touch with burner SIM +91 98201 44892.

policeStation: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Mumbai Zonal Unit
incidentLocation: Shed 4B, Bhiwandi Multi-Logistics Container Park, Thane
seizedItems: 40-foot Sea Container (TGHU-940128-4) disguised as Marine Machinery Parts
Tampered ISO Customs High-Security Bottle Seals
Forged Marine Bill of Lading BL-NSICT-8819
ANPR toll log showing Black Scorpio MH-01-EA-4920 entering compound
briefFacts: DRI team intercepted an illicit container tampering operation in progress at Bhiwandi Logistics Yard operated by Vikram Solanki. Contraband disguised inside export cargo destined for Jebel Ali / Dubai under bill of lading linked to Apex Marine Exports. Security guards confirmed a black SUV (MH-01-EA-4920) registered to an 'R. Khan' visited the depot 2 hours prior to load consolidation. Vikram Solanki received advance coordination calls from +91 98201 44892.
